title: ABCmouse: Kids Learning Games
reason: Listed by https://getsuperteacher.com/blog/khan-academy-kids-vs-alternatives: Khan Academy Kids Alternatives Sept 2026 — ABCmouse by Age of Learning is a broad activity library for children ages 2 to 8, covering reading, math, science, art, and music. It runs on a gamified model, with rewards like virtual pets to motivate continued use, and includes a parent progress dashboard. It's [priced at $14.99/month](https://support.abcmouse.com/hc/en-us/articles/34385411866391-Subscription-Pricing-Options-for-ABCmouse).
